dataset.name: IBM Telco Customer Churn
dataset.description: External benchmark dataset (7,043 subscribers) with contract, service subscriptions, monthly/total charges, CLTV, and churn.

notes: Coerced Total Charges to numeric; imputed 11 blank entries using Monthly Charges * Tenure Months.
Dropped post-hoc leakage columns (Churn Score, Churn Reason, Churn Label) and geo/constant columns.
Excluded CLTV and churn_value from predictive feature_cols to prevent target leakage.
Engineered service_count, avg_monthly_spend, charge_tenure_ratio, has_streaming, has_security_bundle, is_long_term_contract, is_auto_pay.

offer_acceptance_model.model: LightGBM Offer Acceptance Predictor (Source B Synthetic)
offer_acceptance_model.note: Trained on Source B synthetic campaign exposure logs to demonstrate Module 3 (Offer Acceptance Prediction). Cannot be claimed as real-world campaign effectiveness.

policy_comparison.note: Simulated policy comparison (top 30% targeted) combining Source A models with Source B learned Offer Acceptance probabilities. Illustrative simulation only.

stage5b_uplift_simulation.note: SIMULATED UPLIFT EXPERIMENT: No historical campaign treatment/response data exists in this dataset. Treatment assignment W and retention lift are semi-synthetic to benchmark S-Learner, T-Learner, and X-Learner.

stage6_explainability.note: SHAP values explain model behavior (feature contributions to predicted risk/value), not causal reasons why a customer churns or whether an offer will causally retain them.

optional_nlp_insights.note: Analyzed 1,869 post-churn reason records from IBM Telco using TF-IDF + NMF (excluded from predictive churn training to prevent target leakage).
